title: How Fast Does Content Spoil?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A three-shelf market stall that sorts six kinds of content by how quickly they go out of date, with a date stamp telling a reviewer how often to check each one.

educational.topic: Matching the checking schedule to how fast content ages
learningObjectives: The learner will match each of six kinds of content to how fast it ages and how often a reviewer should check it.
prerequisites: The currency half of the accuracy and currency metric from [Chapter 5](../../chapters/05-accuracy-currency/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: How fast does this kind of content age?
commonMisconceptions: Every page needs the same checking schedule
assessmentOpportunities: How often do you check standards, curricula, and guidelines?
Why not use one currency rule for every page?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
